content:
A minor announcement: there is now new more uniform #search syntax for searching Lean within VS code, using LeanSearch, Moogle or LeanStateSearch based on configuration and context (as suggested by @Kim Morrison ).

The new queries are of four forms:

  • Command syntax: #search "search query" as a command.
  • Term syntax: #search "search query" as a term.
  • Tactic syntax: #search "search query" as a tactic.
  • Tactic syntax based on state: #search.

The state search uses LeanStateSearch while the other three commands use either LeanSearch or Moogle depending on the option leansearchclient.backend, which must be either "leansearch" (the deafult) or "moogle".

The more specific commands such as #moogle continue to work the same way as before.

This change was made a while back, but is being announced now as those who have updated with the new stable Mathlib will have the syntax available.
